package consumer

import (
	och "ofam.dev/ochazuke"
)

func register(r *och.Runtime, noun, verb string) {
	r.Register(och.Operation{
		Key: "task.done",
		Run: func(*och.Runtime, och.Context, och.Arguments) (any, error) { return nil, nil },
	})
	r.Register(och.Operation{Key: och.KeyOf(noun, verb), AppHandler: func(och.Ctx) och.Result { return och.Done(nil) }})
	op := r.Operations.At("task.done")
	op.Description = op.Noun() + " " + op.Name()
	r.Operations.Set(op)
	if got, ok := r.Operations.Find(och.Key(noun + "." + verb)); ok {
		got.Key = och.KeyOf(got.Noun(), "again")
		_ = got.AppHandler
	}
	for key, o := range r.Operations.Entries() {
		_, _ = key, o.Key.Short()
	}
	r.Operations.Delete(op.Key)
	_ = r.Operations.Len()
	var a och.UserOperation
	_ = a
}
